* Plain date
  SCHEDULED: <2026-05-01 Fri>
  Body.

* Date with time
  SCHEDULED: <2026-05-01 Fri 14:00>

* Time range (take start)
  SCHEDULED: <2026-05-01 Fri 14:00-15:30>

* Repeater
  DEADLINE: <2026-05-01 Fri +1w>

* Inactive closed
  CLOSED: [2026-04-30 Thu 09:15]

* Malformed
  SCHEDULED: <abcde>

* All three fields
  SCHEDULED: <2026-05-01 Fri>
  DEADLINE: <2026-05-03 Sun 10:00>
  CLOSED: [2026-04-29 Wed]
